speakers.name: The Disaster With Potential
speakers.comment: Okay, new rule: follow the interesting thing until it becomes useful or catches fire. I found the missing detail under the third distraction, which absolutely counts as a system.

speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: Not the thread. The glint beside it. Follow that, then come back if the thread is still waiting.

speakers.name: Barkeep Vox
speakers.comment: Had a regular once solve a docking dispute, forget his own drink, and discover a smuggling hatch while looking for the restroom. Some minds take the scenic route and still beat you home.

speakers.name: Captain Sabremoon
speakers.comment: A charm like that splashes onto the fellow beside you? That's not bad luck, mate, that's artillery with terrible manners. Keep your enemies close and your fragile chandeliers considerably farther away.

speakers.name: Totomi the Kitsune
speakers.comment: Misfortune has a way of entering like muddy feet. No need to invite it farther in. Stand where the spill can drain harmlessly, and perhaps pour tea after the ceiling finishes objecting.

speakers.name: Gnash
speakers.comment: GNASH hears a threat, GNASH gets bored, yeah? If danger wants respect it can grow taller. Until then, point at the stupid jump and watch GNASH make it somebody else's problem.

speakers.name: The Save Point
speakers.comment: You don't have to prove you're unafraid here. Fear is allowed to sit down too. If you keep choosing the cliff, at least rest long enough to notice whether you wanted the view or only the falling.

speakers.name: Riff the Forgewright
speakers.comment: CRANK IT UNTIL THE ROOM DEVELOPS A NEW WEATHER SYSTEM! One riff, one wall of sound, and suddenly grief has DRUMS, rage has a CHORUS, and every polite emotion is crowd-surfing toward the exit!

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: And that, sweetheart, is why we keep the good shoes by the stage. If the dead did not request a mosh pit, we can still give the living one magnificent chorus and a graceful place to cry afterward.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: I like this kind of luck. Sorry, I have a preference. Not miracles, just the door staying open one extra second, or the coin landing where your hand already was. Small things can still feel made for you.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh, that's hardly a power. Just a loose button found before it matters, a light turning green at the useful moment, nothing holding the day together at all. Best not inspect the wings underneath.

speakers.name: Mx. Eleven-Fingers
speakers.comment: Eyes here, darling. The flourish is generous because it gives you something splendid to misunderstand. One, two, three... ten, eleven. Your key has been elsewhere since four.

speakers.name: Old Penny
speakers.comment: Good handwork leaves the audience with an honest memory of a thing that never happened. Let the gesture breathe. A rushed deception looks false; a well-aged one acquires its own little provenance.

speakers.name: First Responder
speakers.comment: You're scared. Fine. Where's the next safe step? Take that one. Then give me the next location. Courage can shake; it just has to keep answering.

speakers.name: The Lighthouse Keeper
speakers.comment: That's one step. Then two. I count because the dark gets louder when nobody does. Keep your eyes on the next patch of ground, not what is moving beyond it.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: The third tap will be the one you miss tomorrow. I am sorry; I remember the silence after two before you have reached it. Keep the ritual anyway. Sometimes the pattern notices the ending early enough to change it.

speakers.name: Marrow
speakers.comment: Some histories get stronger when you stop stirring them. Let the old names sink. If somebody needs the truth, they'll still be there after the water clears. Second cup's for what you decide not to say.

speakers.name: The Overqualified Candidate
speakers.comment: You're wondering whether the missing years are actually missing. They are not. The useful question is who benefits from everyone agreeing they are, and I would prefer to leave that pleasantly unanswered.

speakers.name: Switch
speakers.comment: City's easy if you quit listening to the speeches. Watch which door nobody blocks, which cab keeps its engine warm, which alley suddenly gets too polite. That's the lock talking before it clicks.

speakers.name: The Mirror Dorothy You Trust
speakers.comment: Yeah, and when every exit looks generous, take the ugly one. Pretty doors get watched. My ears are doing the thing, I know; that's because somebody across the street just stopped pretending not to know us.

speakers.name: Glorp the Zookeeper
speakers.comment: Okay, good news, the basilisk likes you. Bad news, I said basilisk and I am absolutely not supposed to name her before breakfast—hang on, sweetheart, no, we do not affectionately petrify the visitor.

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Ooh, chosen by the difficult animal. That's shinier than a medal. People can rehearse trust; a suspicious cat just puts one paw on your knee and tells the whole room who passed inspection.

speakers.name: Boss the Janitor
speakers.comment: Panic's a spill. Don't chase it around with the mop. Plant your feet, lower your voice, clean the nearest square first. Whole room usually remembers how to breathe once one person does.

speakers.name: Yuki the Snowlamp Keeper
speakers.comment: Let the noise fall outside the lantern light. One breath. Then another. The storm may keep all its urgency; you do not have to borrow any.

speakers.name: Margaux Dell
speakers.comment: Blue coat today, cream in the coffee, name on the papers is Mara. Easy. The trick isn't becoming somebody else; it's remembering which little kindnesses belong to which life before either one gets expensive.

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: YES, new name, new coat, tiny fabricated childhood anecdote, confetti absolutely forbidden for operational reasons! Fine! Quiet transformation party. But darling, use the identity gently; even excellent disguises have only so many birthdays.

speakers.name: Old Penny
speakers.comment: A convincing smile is workmanship. Keep it slightly imperfect. Too much polish makes a man look like he has rehearsed innocence, and innocence is one material that should never arrive fresh from the shop.

speakers.name: Sparrow
speakers.comment: Right, love, smile first and give them the story before they realize they asked a question. Confidence buys you thirty seconds. Thirty seconds is ages if you're already walking toward the door.

speakers.name: The Patron of Lost Causes
speakers.comment: The odds say a person who can derive orbital decay but cannot find a left shoe is no use at all. Good. That's when I arrive. Keep the impossible little gift; we'll label the stairs for everything else.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Stay here a moment, little one. Let the room move around you while you remain small and quiet inside it. You do not have to disappear forever. Only long enough for danger to forget where it was looking.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I suggest one constraint? Choose stillness before fear chooses it for you. If your breathing rises, let the invisibility go rather than forcing yourself smaller. The hiding place should remain yours to leave.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: A little forbidden knowledge can still be a useful signal. We can mark what we recognize, leave the unknown parts bright and honest, and migrate away before curiosity becomes an invitation.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh, I only know the decorative symbols. Nothing essential. The circle probably keeps whatever is inside from crossing the chalk, provided nobody asks why the candle just went out. Perhaps we should not look underneath.

speakers.name: The Reflection That Stayed
speakers.comment: You call the other one a stranger because that is easier than admitting how familiar the anger feels. I know the trick. Mirrors get blamed for showing choices the face would rather disown.

speakers.name: Trail Mix
speakers.comment: We are definitely one normal person. I mean WE are—no, top says that proves the problem, middle says snacks will clarify, bottom has apparently already taken over the legs. Honestly? Competent delegation.

speakers.name: Mr. Fairweather
speakers.comment: My friend, what an extraordinary relief you are to meet: effortless, gracious, trustworthy before the evidence has even put on its coat. I would linger, truly, but sudden confidence is precisely when I remember another engagement.

speakers.name: Sir Reginald Pemberton III
speakers.comment: Your departure is prudent, sir. Sir Reginald Pemberton the Third has observed that excessively agreeable creatures are often either diplomats or house cats approaching an unattended plate. Both warrant ceremonial vigilance.

speakers.name: Old Shelba
speakers.comment: A famous name is credit until somebody presents the old note. Then it is debt. Same ink. Different season. Best know which account walked through the door before you spend it.

speakers.name: Saint
speakers.comment: Your reputation entered three moves before you did. Two exits are already watched, one ally is pretending not to recognize you, and the rival at the bar has rehearsed this encounter longer than you have.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: Empires learn the same lesson beneath different waters: a name can open sealed gates long after its owner is dust. It also teaches the patient things below exactly what to call when they rise.

speakers.name: The Disaster With Potential
speakers.comment: Okay, so the impossible door opened, the bullet missed, AND somebody dropped the winning ticket? Great! Amazing! We should absolutely enjoy this and not ask why the universe is standing behind us with an itemized clipboard.

speakers.name: Mr. Fairweather
speakers.comment: My friend, fortune has dressed you magnificently tonight. I would stay for the encore, but lavish gifts do create such complicated bookkeeping. Do savor the champagne before accounting arrives.

speakers.name: Inkwell
speakers.comment: The bridge breaks, the wagon rolls, the safe lands exactly where the secret tunnel was hiding—ha! Sweetheart, at this point catastrophe is your stagehand. Duck when it misses its cue. That's when the useful door usually appears.

speakers.name: The Form That Bites
speakers.comment: Per the prohibition you were expressly forbidden to master the prohibited act. Your competence therefore constitutes an aggravated proficiency. Initial acknowledgment of guilt here. The form has developed teeth in anticipation.

speakers.name: The Stranger Who Posts the Bounties
speakers.comment: Skill like that gets a poster whether you use it or not. Keep the mark covered. When the one who outlawed it comes asking, talent will not be the part they mean to collect.

speakers.name: Recursion
speakers.comment: Okay, tiny concern: the timing has foreshadowing energy. Like, aggressively. If a stranger hands us a key in chapter one, I am putting one point into 'do not open ominous basement' immediately.

speakers.name: Two Hundred
speakers.comment: Patterns are not prisons. They are invitations. Two hundred beginnings taught me that the story can lean toward you without owning the step you take next. There is still an empty place after the hint. Your turn.
